literal: In all possible ways, action is indeed good; when not possible, having considered the way it will succeed, to do.
translation: In every possible way, performing an action is good; if it is not possible, one should find a viable path to success and then act.
modern: இயலும் வழிகளிலெல்லாம் செயலைச் செய்வது நல்லது; இயலாதபோது, அது வெற்றியடையும் வழியை ஆராய்ந்து செய்ய வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet advises on the execution of tasks under different circumstances. In all situations where it is possible (ஒல்லும் வாய் எல்லாம்), performing the action directly is highly beneficial. However, when direct execution is not possible (ஒல்லாக்கால்), one must carefully analyze and find an alternative path or method that will lead to success (செல்லும்வாய் நோக்கி) and then proceed to act (செயல்). The key words 'ஒல்லும் வாய்' (possible ways) and 'செல்லும் வாய்' (viable paths of success) contrast the direct approach with the strategic, adaptive approach. Note: 'ஙல்லும்' is a variant/scribal representation of 'ஒல்லும்' in this context.
